response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced generalist engineer, but does not meet the core mandatory requirements: his C++ experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments (~7 months) and a thesis project, far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. He also lacks fixed-income, capital-markets, or investment-banking domain expertise, and shows no SQL Server or Oracle experience. His strengths lie in web/full-stack and D-language development, which do not transfer directly to this role.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across platforms
Solid low-latency/high-performance systems experience (DLang at Dunnhumby)
Strong CI/CD, testing, and DevOps practices with clear communication skills
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience, none recent and none Windows-focused
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain background
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience (only MongoDB/MySQL)

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain
Strong general engineering fundamentals and CI/CD
